title: Final evaluation, ablations, statistical evidence, and result tables
status_justification: All final aggregate metrics, ablations, statistical tests, counterfactual results, tables/figures, and claim decisions are complete on benchmark-v2 (the FINAL benchmark). External validation is the only blocked item: eICU exists but its APACHE/body-system tokens do not map to the ICD/SNOMED/RxNorm ontology (0/500 records fire), so external validation is honestly blocked (schema mismatch) and documented as future work.
final_main_method: ontology-centered: S_main = S_ont (real Phase 3b rule packs). Detector reported as a diagnostic/negative result; Sgen excluded.
final_score_equation: S_cal = (w_det*S_det + w_ont*S_ont')/(w_det+w_ont) with w_gen=0; recommended main = S_ont (detector non-additive).

ontology_rule_ablation.interpretation: No single rule family reaches the full 0.7881; the three families synergize. Normal FP: full 0.13, demographic 0.16%, medication 6.4%, forbidden 6.7%.

external_validation.detail: eICU uses APACHE/body-system tokens; 0/500 records map to the ICD/SNOMED/RxNorm ontology. Needs an APACHE->ICD/SNOMED crosswalk + eICU anomaly injection (future work).
external_validation.recommended_scope: MIMIC-IV-only paper; external validation = future work.

tests.note: see tests/test_phase7_*.py; full suite reported in the run

next_step: Phase 8 (paper writing + reproducibility package) may proceed as a MIMIC-IV-only, ontology-centered paper. Do NOT overclaim detector value, Sgen, external validation, or clinical validity. External validation on eICU requires an APACHE->ICD/SNOMED crosswalk (separate future phase).
